plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 118 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.4221, -120.52805, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 5.2 km one way. About 103 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
